summary: Reviewed-source candidate correction to the initial LEARN-02 baseline: exact full telemetry batch bytes are reconstructed before remote reads, cooperating recorders share per-Delivery host custody/lock across intent directories, possible-send phases are fsynced before comment POST or telemetry submit, and exact native comment ID/body readback is required. Uncertain comment sends cannot automatically repost; a unique late readback can resolve them. Uncertain telemetry sends require receiver reconciliation and cannot automatically resubmit. No live recording or adoption is established. The retained original aggregate SQL lacked the documented expected-dispatch join and a lineage uniqueness guard. The checked successor requires the Claude dispatch relation, deduplicates item/invocation pairs and refuses ambiguous invocation assignment. Read-only control counts were 74 lineage rows, 74 distinct assignments, zero ambiguous invocations and 34 attributed identities; aggregates equal the original retained rows, so the small-sample statistical findings remain unchanged. Raw private evidence remains outside Atlas. This supersedes the prototype recording description; the cited source and owning design define the proposed framework policy and its limits.
title: LEARN-02 versioned hardness baseline and dispatch observation
